chunks: From him, from al-Naḍr, from ʿĀṣim, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
If you catch the takbir before the Imam bows in rukuʿ, then you have caught the salat (prayer).

key_terms.أَدْرَكْتَ: you reached or caught in time
key_terms.التَّكْبِيرَةَ: the opening or relevant takbir by which one joins the prayer
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the leader of the congregational prayer
key_terms.يَرْكَعَ: to bow in rukuʿ during the prayer

ai.seo_question: When is congregational salat considered caught before the Imam bows?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about joining congregational salat (prayer). It states that if a person reaches the takbir before the Imam goes into rukuʿ, the prayer is considered caught.
